scripts.measure-control.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
out=Path('.work/vm-data-call-route-20261115').resolve();commands=[]
for args in [('measure','1'),('measure','2')]:
 command=[sys.executable,str(out/'control.py'),*args]
 with (out/('control-'+'-'.join(args)+'.log')).open('wb') as log:subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 commands.append(command);(out/'control-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+'\n');print(args,'complete',flush=True)
scripts.measure-all.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.work/vm-data-call-route-20261115'
def linux(p):
 s=p.resolve().as_posix();return '/mnt/'+s[0].lower()+s[2:]
commands=[]
for platform in ['windows','linux']:
 for series in [1,2]:
  cmd=([sys.executable,str(out/'run.py'),'compare','--series',str(series)] if platform=='windows' else ['wsl','--exec','python3',linux(out/'run-linux.py'),'compare','--series',str(series)])
  with (out/f'{platform}-compare-{series}.log').open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  commands.append({'platform':platform,'series':series,'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode});(out/'measurement-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+'\n');assert r.returncode==0
  print(platform,series,'complete',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.work/vm-data-call-route-20261115';cmd=['zig','build','-Dtarget=x86_64-linux-musl','-Doptimize=fast','-Dcpu=baseline','-Dstrip=true','--prefix',str(out/'linux'),'--summary','all']
with (out/'linux-build.log').open('wb') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=out/'source',stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert r.returncode==0
p=out/'linux/bin/sigma';(out/'linux-build.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size},indent=2)+'\n');print('Linux build passed')

creation_script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.work/vm-data-call-route-20261115';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
src=out/'source'
for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines():
 p=root/name
 if p.is_file() and (name.startswith('src/') or name in ('build.zig','build.zig.zon','VERSION','LICENSE','THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md')):
  dest=src/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
p=root/'.work/vm-pc-windows-20261115/forth-reviewed-candidate.zig';data=p.read_bytes();s=data.decode();needle='                    if (call_kind == .call) switch (word.kind) {'
assert s.count(needle)==1
insert='''                    // Experiment: handle simple data words before the kind dispatcher.
                    // DOES> words retain their existing helper path.
                    if (call_kind == .call and
                        (word.kind == .constant or word.kind == .array or
                        ((word.kind == .variable or word.kind == .created) and !word.has_does)))
                    {
                        try self.push(word.value);
                        continue;
                    }
'''
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle);(src/'src/forth.zig').write_bytes(s.encode())
(out/'trial.patch').write_text(subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--',str(p),str(src/'src/forth.zig')],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'purpose':'scratch-only simple data word route control; CPU mechanism unconfirmed','production_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'src/forth.zig').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'prior_candidate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'trial_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
cmd=['zig','build','-Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu','-Doptimize=fast','-Dcpu=baseline','-Dstrip=true','--prefix',str(out/'windows'),'--summary','all']
with (out/'build.log').open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=src,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('build exit',r.returncode)
